loyalty_candidate.description: High-tenure, top-tier or high-spending customers with pristine payment records and high satisfaction.
loyalty_candidate.guidelines: Express deep gratitude, recognize tier status, highlight exclusive curated rewards without promotional pressure.

payment_reminder.description: Accounts with positive overdue balances requiring staged notification and dispute resolution.
payment_reminder.guidelines: Never combine with promotional marketing. State exact verified amount and due date. Provide dispute and hardship paths.

stage_1.label: Courteous Reminder
stage_1.intent: Gentle prompt assuming innocent delay or billing transition.

stage_2.label: Urgent Follow-up
stage_2.intent: Clear notice of pending disruption risk and prompt payment arrangement options.

stage_3.label: Final Notice & Assistance
stage_3.intent: Formal overdue notice emphasizing hardship assistance and immediate resolution.

declining_activity.description: Customers whose product usage or feature engagement has dropped sharply without payment default.
declining_activity.guidelines: Acknowledge changing usage needs, propose tailored feature optimization or data boost, invite feedback.

dormant.description: Customers with no recent activity for extended periods who may be at churn risk.
dormant.guidelines: Gentle check-in, respect their space, invite honest feedback on service fit, offer low-friction welcome back.

consistent.description: Solid ongoing engagement, steady plan adoption, and reliable on-time payments.
consistent.guidelines: Reinforce loyalty value, thank them for their ongoing partnership, share relevant perk if eligible.

required_disclaimers.billing: If you have already remitted payment within the last 48 hours, please accept our thanks and disregard this notice. For payment plans or dispute review, contact customer support at support@telecom-retail.example.com.
required_disclaimers.general: You received this email according to your account communication preferences. Manage preferences in your customer portal.
required_disclaimers.offer: Terms, conditions, and eligibility criteria apply. Offers cannot be exchanged for cash and are valid through the stated expiry date.
